subtitle: Business Communication

keywords: Business English 2.Speaking and Listening 3.Reading and Writing 4.Presentation 5.Digital Literacy
educationalGoal: In this course, students will engage with English in simulated business situations. Students will employ English vocabulary and phrases to complete business tasks effectively. Students will participate in group activities including discussions, interviews, role plays, and presentations to develop both their understanding of the business environment as well as the four language skills of speaking, listening, reading, and writing.
advice: 1. In order to develop English communication skills for business situations, the majority of class will be conducted through group work. When completing projects, it will be necessary to work cooperatively with group members. 2. Group work includes activities such as presentations and discussions. English will be used for these activities. 3. While conducting group work, each student must actively participate and contribute to the completion of the activities.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic English grammar is necessary.

activityGoals.body: Learn vocabulary and phrases used in the workplace and use them appropriately in business settings.
Learn how to do business tasks such as market research, presentations, and advertisement making.
Understand the differences between Japanese and foreign business cultures and appropriately apply them.
Learn the foundations of digital literacy and appropriately apply them.

Students will employ English vocabulary and phrases to complete business tasks effectively. Students will participate in group activities including discussions, interviews, role plays, and presentations to develop both their understanding of the business environment as well as the four language skills of speaking, listening, reading, and writing.
    授業の概要および学習上の助言   1. In order to develop English communication skills for business situations, the majority of class will be conducted through group work. When completing projects, it will be necessary to work cooperatively with group members. 2. Group work includes activities such as presentations and discussions. English will be used for these activities. 3. While conducting group work, each student must actively participate and contribute to the completion of the activities.
